contentText: In tonight's edition, Senegal faces two-time champions France in New Jersey in a kickoff for the group of death at the World Cup. Also,  Africa CDC warns the Ebola crisis in Congo has the potential to become the worst ever of its kind. And 50 years ago, thousands of  young south africans from Soweto  protested against apartheid's stranglehold on their education  and the imposition of Afrikaans as a language of instruction.
